name: touch-playthrough
description: #200: a diagnostic of #120 stretch 2's blocker, on the #200 branch only (the merged scenario is stretch 1). The input is the generated segments touch-1-first-battle, touch-2-md1-1-diagnostic (runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js). Stretch 1's waits still fail the scenario on a timeout. Only signs and small state values leave.
